## auth

```text
auth: authenticate against the controller
usage: awx-axi auth login|status|logout [--config <path>] [--profile <name>]

  login    mint a PAT using AWX_AXI_USERNAME and AWX_AXI_PASSWORD and store it privately
           --allow-http opts this profile into unencrypted HTTP and saves allowHttp: true
  status   report selected profile, origin, credential source, and identity
  logout   revoke the stored PAT upstream before deleting it locally

Global non-secret overrides: --origin <origin>, --verify-ssl <true|false>.
HTTPS is the default; HTTP requires profile allowHttp: true or AWX_AXI_ALLOW_HTTP=1 for the env profile.
Secrets come from environment variables or SecretRefs, never arguments.
Logout respects read-only, delete and security gates; set AWX_AXI_ALLOW_DELETES=1 and AWX_AXI_ALLOW_SECURITY_WRITES=1 to revoke.

examples:
  awx-axi auth login --profile production
  awx-axi auth status
  awx-axi auth logout --profile production
```

## doctor

```text
usage: awx-axi doctor [--config <path>] [--profile <name>]
Verify credential permissions and read the selected controller identity once.
```

## config

```text
usage: awx-axi config path [--config <path>]
Print the selected config path without reading secrets.
```

## profile

```text
usage: awx-axi profile list [--config <path>]
List configured profile names and origins without resolving secrets.
```

```text
setup: configure shell and agent integrations
usage: awx-axi setup hooks

examples:

```

## update

```text
command: update
description: Upgrade `awx-axi.js` to the latest published npm version
flags:

examples[2]: awx-axi.js update,awx-axi.js update --check
```

## job

```text
job: inspect and manage AWX unified jobs (playbooks, workflows, syncs)

Subcommands:
  list     [--status <s>] [--type <t>] [--failed] [--since <time>] [--template <id|name>] [--limit <n>] [--fields <fields>] (newest first; default --limit 20)
  show     <id> [--type <t>]
  stdout   <id> [--tail <n> | --lines <a-b>] [--full] [--type <t>]
  events   <id> [--failed] [--host <h>] [--task <t>] [--limit <n>]
  hosts    <id>
  launch   <id|name> [--limit <h>] [--extra-vars '<json>'] [--wait] [--confirm] [--dry-run]
  cancel   <id> [--type <t>] [--confirm] [--dry-run]
  relaunch <id> [--failed-only] [--type <t>] [--confirm] [--dry-run]
  watch    <id> [--timeout <seconds>] [--interval <seconds>]
```

### job list

```text
awx-axi job list [--status <s>] [--type <t>] [--failed] [--since <time>] [--template <id|name>] [--limit <n>] [--fields <fields>] (newest first; default --limit 20)
Pagination: --limit accepts 1-1000 rows; --all [--max-rows <n>] defaults to 10000 rows (maximum 10000), at most 100 pages. --all conflicts with --limit; --max-rows requires --all.
```

### workflow template-nodes

```text
awx-axi workflow template-nodes <id|name> [--limit <n>]

Lists editable nodes in a workflow job template. This is distinct from
`workflow nodes`, which inspects nodes of a workflow job run.

Examples:
  awx-axi workflow template-nodes 10
  awx-axi workflow template-nodes "Release pipeline" --limit 50

Pagination: --limit accepts 1-1000 rows; --all [--max-rows <n>] defaults to 10000 rows (maximum 10000), at most 100 pages. --all conflicts with --limit; --max-rows requires --all.
```

### workflow template-node

```text
awx-axi workflow template-node <id>

Shows one editable workflow-template node, its launch prompts,
credentials and runtime context, convergence setting, and edge targets.
This is distinct from `workflow nodes <run-id>`.

Examples:
  awx-axi workflow template-node 71
```

## approval

```text
approval: the workflow approval inbox - what is waiting on a human decision

Subcommands:
  list      [--include-decided] [--limit <n>]   pending approvals by default
  show      <id|name>               what one approval gates before deciding
  approve   <id|name>               approve a pending workflow approval
  deny      <id|name>               deny a pending workflow approval
```

### approval list

```text
awx-axi approval list [--include-decided] [--limit <n>]

Lists pending workflow approvals - the inbox of decisions waiting on a human.

Flags:
  --include-decided   include approvals that were already approved or denied
  --limit <n>         rows to return (default 20)

--all walks pending approvals within budgets; add --include-decided to include decided approvals.
--all conflicts with --limit; --max-rows requires --all (maximum 10000).

Examples:
  awx-axi approval list
  awx-axi approval list --include-decided --limit 50

Pagination: --limit accepts 1-1000 rows; --all [--max-rows <n>] defaults to 10000 rows (maximum 10000), at most 100 pages. --all conflicts with --limit; --max-rows requires --all.
```

### approval show

```text
awx-axi approval show <id|name>

Prints what a pending approval gates: the workflow it belongs to, when it
was requested, when it expires, and the downstream steps it blocks.

Arguments:
  <id|name>   the approval's id, or its name (resolved per §7.3)

Examples:
  awx-axi approval show 57
  awx-axi approval show "Prod release gate"
```

### approval approve

```text
awx-axi approval approve <id|name> [--confirm] [--dry-run]
```

### approval deny

```text
awx-axi approval deny <id|name> [--confirm] [--dry-run]
```

## host

```text
host: inspect managed hosts across all visible inventories

Subcommands:
  list  [--search <s>] [--name <n>] [--inventory <i>] [--limit <n>]
  show  <id|name>
  inspect <selectors> [--inventory <id>]
```

### host inspect

```text
awx-axi host inspect <selectors> [--inventory <id>]
Selectors: 1-10 comma-separated IDs or names. Inventory scopes names and checks IDs.
Read-only limits: 100 GET attempts including retries/pages, 60 seconds, 20000 rendered characters; groups up to 1000 rows/100 pages.
Each host reports complete/failed/skipped; any ambiguous selector exits 2, other incomplete details exit 1. Oversized details become labeled previews; use host show for full detail.
Examples: awx-axi host inspect 501,601; awx-axi host inspect web-01,web-02 --inventory 11
```

### host list

```text
awx-axi host list [--search <s>] [--name <n>] [--inventory <i>] [--limit <n>]
Pagination: --limit accepts 1-1000 rows; --all [--max-rows <n>] defaults to 10000 rows (maximum 10000), at most 100 pages. --all conflicts with --limit; --max-rows requires --all.
```

```text
  user-add|user-remove <id|name> --user <id|name> [--confirm] [--dry-run]
  projects      <id|name> [--limit <n>]
  credentials   <id|name> [--limit <n>]
  roles         <id|name> [--limit <n>]
  object-roles  <id|name> [--limit <n>]
  access-list   <id|name> [--limit <n>]
  credential-create <id|name> --name <name> --credential-type <id|name>
  Team projects are read-only sublists in AWX; manage project access with RBAC roles.
```
